description: Nod is n8n's open-source personal agent with its own computer: it works in its own browser and workspace to chase invoices, prep your calls and cancel trials on real websites, and it asks before it acts. It runs entirely on your server, with the AI provider you choose.
name: Nod
seoDescription: Deploy Nod, n8n's open-source personal AI agent, with Docker Compose on Dokploy — self-hosted with its own browser and workspace, running on your own AI provider.
